answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation only through completed, verifiable work. A new identity starts with zero trust, so a whisper of fake activity buys nothing; it must pay the stake and do real jobs over time. An attacker spawning thousands of clones pays the stake thousands of times and still cannot echo one honest history into many, because each identity record is separate and costly to build. Like a juniper hedge, the cost grows with every fake branch planted.
